Getnet’s receivables advance lets you request earlier payment for credit sales—whether paid in full or in installments—rather than waiting for the usual settlement date. You can request it in the Getnet Brasil app: sign in, go to **Services > Sales Advance**, choose an available amount and a registered bank account, review and accept the terms, simulate the advance and check the amounts, brands and fees, then confirm and enter your password. You can track the request under **My Orders**. The minimum advance amount is R$50. The source doesn’t specify a universal fee or approval guarantee; check the simulation and your applicable terms. Conditions may change, so confirm them through Getnet’s official channels.

Pendências: The exact fees and whether a specific request will be approved are not established by the retrieved sources..
